svg.title: MOOTx01 full architectural taxonomy
svg.desc: Seven layers from publication artifacts down to the twelve-kit substrate, the universal lattice, the estate hierarchy, and a summary of the six-rung representation ladder per drawer.
svg.text: Layer 1: what gets published to the world
Layer 2: deployment products built on the engine
Layer 3: framework profiles loaded at estate creation
Layer 4: the twelve-kit substrate (the engine, framework-agnostic)

g.text: composes the substrate kits, runs the Brain layer, coordinates N estates

svg.text: Layer 5: universal lattice (committed v1: UDC + Wikidata)
Estates declare a zoom window into this lattice. Federation overlap = window comparison.
Layer 6: hierarchy (Estate to Wing to Room to Drawer, top-down read)

g.text: Estate: property line of one knower, has manifest, has zoom window
Wing: major life domain or knowledge area
Room: specific topic or named category

svg.text: Layer 7: six representation rungs per drawer (summary; see the rung-ladder diagram)
Each rung is model and version tagged. Full detail in the rung-ladder diagram.
